svg.aria-label: Change Saga data model: what is persisted in the Saga, what lives in Git, and what is derived on read
svg.title: Change Saga data model

g.text: How Change Saga’s data fits together
The Saga stores explanation and exact pins; Git holds the code; coverage, currency and queries are computed from both on read.
Select an entity or edge to open its definition and exact code. Selected entities only; the directory below lists them all.
GIT · SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR CODE

g.title: Feature (0..*) belongs to (1) Saga manifest: persisted association
Story (0..*) lives in (1) Feature: persisted association
Story (0..*) serves (0..*) Persona: persisted association
Acceptance criterion (0..*) criterion of (1) Story: persisted association
Deck (0..*) implements (0..1) Feature: persisted association
Deck (1) explains (0..1) Review: persisted association
Slide (0..*) in (1) Deck: persisted association
Item (0..*) on (1) Slide: persisted association
Item (0..*) documented by (0..1) Technical definition: persisted association
Item (0..*) links (0..*) Acceptance criterion: persisted association
Code reference (0..*) evidence of (0..1) Item: persisted association
Code reference (0..*) evidence of (0..1) Technical definition: persisted association
Merge record (0..1) freezes (0..1) Review: persisted association
Source repository and commits (1) documented by (unknown) Saga manifest: persisted association
Source repository and commits (1) pinned by (0..*) Code reference: persisted association
Source repository and commits landed commits recorded in Merge record: derived, not a key
Source repository and commits diffed into Change set: derived, not a key
Change set measured into Coverage report: derived, not a key
Code reference matched into Coverage report: derived, not a key
Coverage report extended into Reconciliation queue: derived, not a key
Coverage report cached in Snapshot cache: derived, not a key
Saga manifest projected into Query response: derived, not a key
Saga manifest: app.saga/saga.json
Feature: feature.json
Persona: revisions + events
Review: + approvals, comments
Deck: flat deck bundle
Story: revisions + lifecycle
Merge record: ___merges/<commit>.json
Slide: one visual argument
Acceptance criterion: inside a story revision
Technical definition: held by record store
Item: owns deck evidence
Code reference: exact pinned bytes
Source repository and commits: .git — the only copy of the code
g.text: file bytes at each commit (read with git cat-file)
.git — the only copy of the code

g.title: Query response: AI read API, bounded
Snapshot cache: user cache dir, disposable
Reconciliation queue: reconcile --against
Coverage report: computed, never stored
Change set: git diff merge-base..head

g.text: produced from (derived data, never a key)
Crow’s-foot marks beside an entity: how many of it per one of the other. Keys are roles in the records, not constraints.
In the directory, not drawn: Relation (pinned traceability edges) and Review decision (per-slide approvals).
